nodes.label: WorkOrderTable
nodes.rationale: Renders a table of work orders with links, status/priority badges, and relative timestamps; handles empty state with inline message.

nodes.label: WorkOrderForm
nodes.rationale: Client component that fetches active equipment from Supabase, then submits via server action formAction pattern with error display from searchParams.

nodes.label: WorkOrderDetailCard
nodes.rationale: Displays full work order details and conditionally renders an inline status update form using bind to pass workOrder.id to the server action.

nodes.label: PMTable
nodes.rationale: Displays PM schedules in a table with inline status badges derived from getPMStatus and a Start PM button that calls startPMTask via formAction.

nodes.label: BottomNav
nodes.rationale: Mobile-only bottom navigation bar using usePathname for active link detection; hidden on lg+ breakpoints.

nodes.label: Sidebar
nodes.rationale: Desktop-only sidebar navigation rendering NAV_ITEMS with icon mapping and active link detection via usePathname; hidden below lg.

nodes.label: AppHeader
nodes.rationale: Server component that fetches current user via getCurrentUser and renders avatar dropdown with signout action; uses DropdownMenu pattern where signout is a form submission.

nodes.label: EmptyState
nodes.rationale: Reusable shared component providing a consistent empty-state visual with title, description, and optional action slot.

nodes.label: StatusBadge
nodes.rationale: Shared pill badge component that maps a status string to a color via the statusColor utility and renders with cn-based styling.

nodes.label: PriorityBadge
nodes.rationale: Shared pill badge component structurally identical to StatusBadge but uses priorityColor utility and displays the priority value directly.

nodes.label: LowStockAlert
nodes.rationale: Dashboard widget that filters parts by min_threshold, shows a yellow alert with list of low-stock items linking to /parts; returns null if none.

nodes.label: ActivityFeed
nodes.rationale: Dashboard widget showing last 10 work orders with equipment name, status badge, and relative timestamp; links to detail pages.

nodes.label: OverduePMAlert
nodes.rationale: Dashboard widget that filters PM schedules by overdue status using getPMStatus, shows a red alert with links to /pm-schedules/:id.

nodes.label: StatsCards
nodes.rationale: Dashboard summary cards showing total equipment, open work orders, overdue PMs, and low-stock parts counts with icons and colors.

nodes.label: PartsTable
nodes.rationale: Displays parts inventory with inline low-stock indicators; each row has a Restock button opening a Dialog with a form that calls restockPart server action.

nodes.label: BarcodeDisplay
nodes.rationale: Renders a CODE128 barcode SVG via JsBarcode library from a given value string.

nodes.label: BarcodeScanner
nodes.rationale: Client component with three modes (idle/scan/manual) for barcode input; uses html5-qrcode for camera scanning and routes to /report?tag= on successful decode.

nodes.label: FaultForm
nodes.rationale: Report form with equipment info card, photo capture via file input with accept=image/* and capture=environment, and server action submission to submitFaultReport.

nodes.label: EquipmentPMTab
nodes.rationale: Async server component that dynamically imports supabase server client, queries pm_schedules by equipment_id, and renders PM list with status derived from getPMStatus.

nodes.label: EquipmentForm
nodes.rationale: Dual-mode form (create/edit) with extensive field inputs for equipment attributes; uses createEquipment or updateEquipment.bind() as formAction depending on presence of equipment prop.

nodes.label: EquipmentInfoTab
nodes.rationale: Read-only display of all equipment fields in a two-column grid, using StatusBadge for status and formatDate for dates.

nodes.label: EquipmentTable
nodes.rationale: Table listing equipment with tag number links to detail pages, StatusBadge, and formatted install dates; handles empty state inline.

nodes.label: EquipmentHistoryTab
nodes.rationale: Async server component that dynamically imports supabase server client, queries work_orders by equipment_id, and renders history list with status/priority badges and timestamps.

nodes.label: ComplianceChart
nodes.rationale: Donut pie chart using recharts showing completed vs pending PM ratio; handles zero-total edge case with placeholder text.

nodes.label: getPMStatus
nodes.rationale: Computes PM schedule status (overdue/due/upcoming/none) from a next_due date; consumed by multiple components across dashboard, PM table, and equipment tabs.

nodes.label: NAV_ITEMS
nodes.rationale: Shared navigation item definitions (href, label, icon name) consumed by Sidebar for rendering nav links with icon lookup.

nodes.label: Server Action Form Pattern
nodes.rationale: Architectural pattern where forms use formAction prop with a server action function (or bind) instead of onSubmit handlers, coupled with searchParams-based error display. This avoids explicit API route creation and leverages Next.js server actions for mutations.

nodes.label: Dashboard Alert Widget Pattern
nodes.rationale: Dashboard widget pattern: receives a data array, filters it for items meeting an alert condition, returns null if none, otherwise renders a colored bordered box with icon header and a link list to detail pages.

nodes.label: Async Server Component Data Fetching
nodes.rationale: Pattern where a component is declared async, dynamically imports the supabase server client at runtime (avoiding client-boundary issues), awaits the query, and renders the result. Used by tab components within client-side page shells.

nodes.label: OKLCH CSS Custom Properties (index.html)
nodes.rationale: OKLCH color space chosen for perceptually uniform colors; blue accent (#2563eb) for primary actions; warm light surfaces with subtle borders

nodes.label: App Shell Layout (Desktop Sidebar + Mobile Bottom Nav)
nodes.norm_label: app shell layout (desktop sidebar + mobile bottom nav)

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Warning
nodes.rationale: This version of Next.js has breaking changes — APIs, conventions, and file structure may differ from training data. Agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: The knowledge graph at graphify-out/ is the primary map of the codebase, with god nodes, community structure, and cross-file relationships. Agents must read GRAPH_REPORT.md before any source file access.

nodes.label: Public Fault Report Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Adds a public (no-login) fault reporting flow where hospital staff scan an equipment barcode and submit a photo + description, which auto-creates a corrective work order. 8 tasks, ~1.5 hours.

nodes.label: Biomedical EMMS Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Build a cloud-hosted biomedical CMMS with corrective maintenance, preventive maintenance, asset management, and parts inventory for a single-hospital department (~5-20 techs, ~2K-10K devices). 25 tasks, ~4.5 hours.

nodes.label: eBiomed Design System Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Apply the new OKLCH-based design system to the existing Next.js 16 app, updating theme tokens, layout shell, and shadcn/ui component styles while preserving all functionality.

nodes.label: Public Fault Reporting Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Public-facing flow: no login required, scan barcode → fill form → auto-create corrective work order. Dependency on existing EMMS schema.

nodes.label: Biomedical EMMS Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Cloud-hosted electronic maintenance management system for a biomedical department. Inspired by UpKeep. No external integrations required — standalone system.

nodes.label: eBiomed Design System Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Replace default shadcn/ui gray/black theme with a refined OKLCH-based system: warm light surfaces, blue primary accent (#2563eb), consistent 8px radius.

nodes.label: /report Public Route (No Auth Required)
nodes.rationale: Public route with no login required — any hospital staff can report equipment faults. Middleware bypass added for /report paths.

nodes.label: User Roles (Admin, Technician, Viewer)
nodes.rationale: Three-tier role system: Admin (full CRUD + user management), Technician (own WOs + view all), Viewer (read-only). Enforced via Supabase RLS.

nodes.label: OKLCH Color Space Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: OKLCH chosen for perceptually uniform colors. Includes semantic color tokens: success (green), warning (yellow), danger (red), info (blue/purple).

nodes.label: Blue Accent #2563eb (Primary Color)
nodes.rationale: #2563eb (Tailwind blue-600) selected as primary accent for active states, primary buttons, and focus rings. Dark mode variant: #3b82f6 (blue-500) for better contrast.
